definitions: A type of rigid foam insulation made from polystyrene polymer, commonly used in construction.
A closed-cell foam material produced by an extrusion process, known for its excellent thermal performance and moisture resistance.
examples: Extruded Polystyrene is often blue or pink.
The foundation was insulated with Extruded Polystyrene.
We specified Extruded Polystyrene for the wall sheathing.
